description: This file defines an AuthProvider React component that manages authentication state, including login, logout, user profile fetching, and role-based access control. It provides context for authentication-related data and functions within a React application.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication context, manages user state, and handles login/logout lifecycle.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook that grants access to the authentication context, enabling components to interact with auth state and functions.
